comment: SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT. Ribs, webs, thin walls and surfaces of a 3D sketch's curves in its sketch plane (mitcad#1550), on the geometry kernel. 3DSketch1 (F1) on XY: A at the origin, AB 40 along +X (c3, its length k3), BC 30 along +Y (c5, to p4), both in the sketch plane, and CD from C up to (40, 30, 20) (c7), out of it.
Box1 (F2): a block under the sketch plane for the web to join (a web joins a body): 65 x 10 x 10 from (-5, -5, -10).
Web1 (F3): a wall 2 thick and 10 deep along AB, the sketch normal up, joined to the block it stands on: 6500 + 40 * 2 * 10.
Extrude1 (F4): thin walls along AB and BC, 2 thick on side 1 (round the outside of the corner B, mitred), 10 high: (2 * 40 + 2 * 30 + 2 * 2) * 10, as from a 2D sketch's L.
Extrude2 (F5): a surface extrusion of AB and BC, 10 up: one sheet, a face per curve.
Rib1 (F6) along CD, out of the sketch plane: it fails, naming the sketch.

expect.error_contains: 3DSketch1's c7 does not lie in its sketch plane

comment: AB to 50 (k3): the web and the walls follow, 6500 + 50 * 2 * 10 and (2 * 50 + 2 * 30 + 2 * 2) * 10.
